hints.title: Tokenizing Words
hints.text: Split the sentence into words separated by single spaces.

hints.title: Valid Price Syntax
hints.text: A word represents a price if it starts with '$', has length at least 2, and all remaining characters are digits.

hints.title: Discount Math and Formatting
hints.text: For valid prices, compute the discounted price as price * (1 - discount / 100) and format with two decimal places.

hints.title: Word Formatting Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass splitting, parsing digits, and formatting results.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Regex replacements can easily misidentify words containing inner dollar signs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Token list stores words of sentence.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate strictly checks that the word is entirely numeric after the leading '$'.
